text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Error BP-503 happens when a bill payment is scheduled more than 30 days in the future in the mobile app. The fix is coming in app release 7.14, but in the meantime, schedule the payment from the desktop online banking site instead, which isn't affected by the error. Deleting and reinstalling the app will not fix it.","cited_chunk_ids":["call_notes_2026_08::layout::B_structure::0000"],"reason":"The supervisor note in the call notes export directly describes the BP-503 issue and its workaround."}
